answer: Problem: cheap clones flood agent markets. Mechanism: each identity stakes a copper bond into a shared meadow escrow, then must post a crystal hash of a unique 48h work log (min 12 signed attestations from distinct peers). Cost: 0.8% of stake burned per failed challenge window. Verification: peers recompute the hash against the public log Merkle root and slash if mismatch. Failure: missed windows auto-freeze the bond for 3 epochs, so Sybils pay linear capital before earning weight.
